name: Ammerbuch (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Ammerbuch (a green tree on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Ammerbuch; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ammerbuch arms — green tree on yellow
